brief: Prioritise Glenmoor Reach for pre-event attention and clear any outstanding vegetation or obstruction defects around the radiator banks, as restricted airflow removes the cooling margin the unit relies on during sustained high ambient conditions [SOP-011]. Because this unit is of advanced age with a history of high loading, it has a reduced margin against mechanical failure and should be prioritised ahead of a younger unit in otherwise similar condition [MG-023]. Where the ageing unit cannot be attended before the event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure [MG-023].
